source_row.item_data_json: {"options":{"A":"Inhale rapidly and forcefully through the device, then exhale into the mouthpiece immediately","B":"Avoid deep inspiration because incentive spirometry is intended only for normal tidal breaths","C":"Inhale slowly and deeply through the mouthpiece, briefly hold the breath, then exhale normally","D":"Exhale forcefully into the device because incentive spirometry primarily trains expiration"}}
source_row.rationale: Correct incentive-spirometer use emphasizes a slow, deep inspiration through the mouthpiece followed by a brief inspiratory hold and relaxed exhalation. It should be used as part of a broader postoperative lung-expansion and mobility plan rather than presented as a stand-alone intervention that independently prevents all pulmonary complications.
source_row.source_detail: Technique section: slow maximal inspiration through mouthpiece with brief breath hold; incentive spirometry should be part of broader postoperative pulmonary care; accessed 2026-08-14.
